types.title: Equipment
types.description: The kinds of equipment you fit or service on vehicles, such as a crane, tail lift or hook loader. Add the first one to record equipment on vehicles and work orders. Until then nothing about equipment shows anywhere.
types.descriptionMarine: The kinds of equipment you fit or service on vessels, such as a crane, davit or winch. Add the first one to record equipment on vessels and work orders. Until then nothing about equipment shows anywhere.

types.hasItems: This type has equipment. Hide it instead, so its items keep their type.

vehicle.deleteHint: Its history, meters, readings and report file are deleted too. To keep them, remove it instead.
